verses.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੮ : ਰੱਬ ਦੀਆਂ ਦਾਤਾਂ ਤੇ ਸਾਡੀ ਭੁੱਲ
verses.translit_en: pauRee 18 : ra'b dheeaa(n) dhaataa(n) te saaddee bhu'l

en.bdb: Gifts of the Lord and our mistakes

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਕਤੁ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਮਿਆ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਲਿਤ੍ਰ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਬਣਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: rakat bi(n)dh kar nimiaa chitr chalitr bachitr banaiaa|

en.bdb: From the blood of mother and semen of father the human body was created and the Lord accomplished this wonderful feat.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਰਭ ਕੁੰਡ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਖਿਆ ਜੀਉਪਾਇ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਜਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: garabh ku(n)dd vich rakhiaa jeeaupai tan saaj suhaiaa|

en.bdb: This human body was kept in the well of the womb. Then life was infused in it and its grandeur was further enhanced.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੁਹੁ ਅਖੀ ਦੇ ਨਕੁ ਕੰਨ ਹਥ ਪੈਰ ਦੰਦ ਵਾਲ ਗਣਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: muh akhee dhe nak ka(n)n hath pair dha(n)dh vaal ganaiaa|

en.bdb: Mouth, eyes, nose, ears, hands, teeth, hair etc. were bestowed upon it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਿਸਟਿ ਸਬਦ ਗਤਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵੈ ਰਾਗ ਰੰਗ ਰਸ ਪਰਸ ਲੁਭਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: dhisaT sabadh gat surat livai raag ra(n)g ras paras lubhaiaa|

en.bdb: Man was given sight, speech, power of listening and consciousness of merging in the Word. For his ears, eyes, tongue and skin, the form, joy, smell etc. were created.

verses.gurmukhi: ਉਤਮੁ ਕੁਲੁ ਉਤਮੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਰੋਮ ਰੋਮ ਗਣਿ ਅੰਗ ਸਬਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: autam kul utam janam rom rom gan a(n)g sabaiaa|

en.bdb: By giving the best family (of human being) and birth in it, the Lord god gave shape to one and all organs.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਮੁਹਿ ਦੁਧਿ ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਮਲ ਮੂਤ੍ਰ ਸੂਤ੍ਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: baal budh muh dhudh dhe kar mal mootr sootr vich aaiaa|

en.bdb: During infancy, mother pours milk into the mouth and make (the baby) defecate.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਸਮਝਿਆ ਕਰਤਾ ਛਡਿ ਕੀਤੇ ਲਪਟਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: hoi siaanaa samajhiaa karataa chhadd keete lapaTaiaa|

en.bdb: When grown up, he (man) leaving aside the creator Lord becomes engrossed with His creation.
Without the perfect Guru, man goes on to be engrossed into the web of maya.
